with open('/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf', 'rb') as f:
    reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)
    text_parts = []
    for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):

doc = fitz.open('/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf')
text_parts = []

    t = page.get_text()
    if t:
        text_parts.append(t)
full_text = '\\n'.join(text_parts)
print(full_text)
print(f'\\n--- Pages: {len(doc)}, Chars: {len(full_text)} ---')
doc.close()
